description: The authors publish a satellite-derived inventory of target cement plants in China for 2012–2022. The Zenodo metadata describes 953 plant records with 23 attributes, including production-status information from annual composite imagery, points of interest and company information. Version two is identified by DOI, and the registry states CC BY 4.0. The inventory can locate industrial facilities in electricity-demand, freight, air-quality or earthquake-exposure simulations. Its plant positions and status indicators are observations inferred by an improved YOLOv5-IEG detection workflow, not verified measurements of each site's capacity, energy use or emissions. The dataset covers target cement plants, not every industrial installation in China. A modeller should check the original attribute definitions and omissions before assigning demand or output to a plant. It complements data-china-cement-industry-dataset-ccid, a distinct Zenodo inventory that reports clinker lines and partial energy statistics, not this image-derived annual status series. The detection model and high-resolution source imagery were not verified as separately reusable resources in this review. No dataset file was downloaded.
